# Webisaurus

> Polyglot syntax reference and multi-language code comparator covering 140 programming languages.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://c.nevatal.id/
- API: https://c.nevatal.id/sitemap.xml
- API Catalog: https://c.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://c.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://c.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://c.nevatal.id/auth.md
